'''Cvoy Pawn''' was a pawn shop in the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Coruscant underworld]]. It was located at [[Terminal 24/Legends|Terminal 24]]. The façade was decorated with a sign with [[Color/Legends|yellow]] [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] letters on a red background, and read "Cvoy" and "Cvoy Pawn".<ref name="To Catch a Jedi" />
